signals.evidence: There is no recent news or current metrics to suggest that Chinese competitors are capturing significant market share in semiconductor factory inspection.

signals.signal: EV and semiconductor factory capex cycle reverses — Cognex revenue declines >15% for two consecutive quarters
signals.evidence: Cognex's current revenue growth YoY is 16.9%, indicating positive growth rather than a decline. There is no recent news suggesting a reversal in capex cycles impacting Cognex's revenue negatively.

signals.signal: General-purpose vision foundation models commoditize industrial vision at <50% of Cognex cost
signals.evidence: There is no recent news or current metrics indicating that general-purpose vision foundation models are commoditizing industrial vision or impacting Cognex's cost structure.

assessment.keyWatchItem: Any news regarding competitive pressures from Chinese machine vision companies or significant shifts in semiconductor/EV capex spending.
